description: The notification plugin (macOS and Linux only; Windows has its own toasts and does not load the plugin) puts a script into every window that asks the system once, as soon as the page loads, whether notifications are allowed (plugin:notification|is_permission_granted). The page itself never calls the plugin (the permission and the notifications are handled by the backend, macnotify.rs / shell.rs), so this is the one command every kind of window needs, and nothing else of the plugin (D-104).
